title: Press kit
updated: Kinboard for Apple TV, iPad and iPhone
lede: Kinboard turns the Apple TV or iPad a family already owns into the family screen, with the iPhone as the remote. For offer codes, interviews or anything else, write to {pressemail}.

facts.v: Kinboard (in the App Store: “Kinboard: Family Calendar”)
Apple TV (tvOS 26) or iPad (iPadOS 26) as the family screen, iPhone (iOS 26) as the remote
Free download with a 14-day free trial of everything. Kinboard+ is a one-time purchase of {price} in the US, with Family Sharing. No subscription, no ads.
Collects no data. No account, no servers of its own, no analytics; everything syncs through the family's own iCloud.

short: Family screen for TV and iPad.
Turn the Apple TV or iPad you already own into the family screen: everyone's calendars, shared lists, kids' chores and the weather. Try everything free for 14 days.

intro: Kinboard turns the Apple TV in your living room or the iPad on your kitchen wall into a family screen. Everyone's day, the grocery list, the kids' chores and the weather - readable from across the room, and always on.
No extra gadget to buy, no account to create, no subscription.

sections.title: Everyone's calendar
points: Each person gets their own color, so you can tell at a glance who is where
Today and tomorrow side by side, with what's happening right now on top
Calendars from your iPhone and iPad, including Google and Outlook accounts added there
Any calendar you can subscribe to by link - school, sports club, holidays

sections.title: Shared lists
points: Groceries, packing and to-dos that anyone can update from their iPhone
Tick items off right on the iPad
Open items appear on the screen and on the Apple TV Top Shelf

sections.title: Kids' chores
points: Daily jobs for each child, on the days you choose
One to three stars per chore, and a weekly star count kids can see
Kids mark chores done themselves on the iPad

sections.title: More on the screen
points: Countdowns to birthdays, trips and the next visit from Grandma
Family photos slowly changing behind the schedule
Night mode dims the screen at bedtime and wakes it in the morning

sections.title: Made for a screen that stays on
points: Keeps the screen awake and refreshes itself
Gently shifts the layout to protect OLED screens
Big rounded type and high contrast, with Bold Text and Increase Contrast support

sections.title: The whole family, one screen
paragraphs: Set everything up from your iPhone and invite your family. Everyone edits the same lists and calendars from their own iPhone, and changes appear on every screen within seconds.

sections.title: Private by design
paragraphs: Kinboard has no servers of its own and no analytics. Everything syncs through your family's iCloud - the developer never sees your calendars, lists or photos.

sections.title: Free trial, then one purchase
paragraphs: Everything is open for 14 days. After that, the clock, weather, countdowns, night mode and one calendar stay free. Kinboard+ is a one-time purchase that unlocks every calendar, shared lists, chores and stars, the photo background, family invitations and the Top Shelf - on Apple TV, iPad and iPhone, and for your whole family through Family Sharing.

features.d: Today and tomorrow side by side, from the calendars on the family's iPhones and iPads (Google and Outlook included) and any calendar link.
Groceries, packing and to-dos anyone can update from their iPhone or tick off on the iPad; open items also appear on the Apple TV Top Shelf.
Daily jobs on the days you choose, one to three stars each, and a weekly star count the kids can see.
Local weather, countdowns to birthdays and trips, and family photos slowly changing behind the schedule.
Keeps the screen awake, refreshes itself, dims at night, gently shifts the layout to protect OLED screens, and supports Bold Text and Increase Contrast.
No account and no analytics. Everything syncs through the family's iCloud, and the developer never sees it.
